probes.name: parenthesized_record
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim target As Workbook, part As Object
Dim sourceText As String
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set target = Workbooks.Add
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "Records"
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Type InnerData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Value As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Type" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Type RecordData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Value As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Nested As InnerData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Values(0 To 1) As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Reference As Collection" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Type" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Private Stored As RecordData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Private Replacement As RecordData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Sub ReplaceRecord(ByRef number As Long)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Stored = Replacement" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "number = number + 10" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Function MakeRecord() As RecordData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "MakeRecord = Stored" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Function" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Sub Change(ByRef item As RecordData)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "item.Value = item.Value + 10" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Function Check() As String" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Dim first As RecordData, second As RecordData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "first.Value = 5" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Change (first)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Check = CStr(first.Value)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Function" & vbCrLf
part.CodeModule.AddFromString sourceText
Probe = CStr(Application.Run("'" & target.Name & "'!Records.Check"))
target.Close False
End Function
